summary.answer: Takes the CoD.ScoreInfoProp instance as f18_arg0. Calls close() with each child as implicit self, in this exact order: FriendlyWinPips, EnemyWinPips, PropLivesEnemy, PropLivesFriendly. There are no guards, branches, loops, explicit return values, field resets, timer cancellation or protected error handling in this body. Missing/already-closed children are not checked; an earlier receiver/provider error may prevent later closes. The same constructor sets this exact class and registers self.__onClose with CallOriginalSecond. That helper controls wrapping/order/invocation; registration alone does not prove game-time delivery.
